stages.name: Preliminary Exam
stages.tests: 100 Qs, 60 min. English, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning Ability.
stages.note: Qualifying. Cut-off per section and overall. No interview for Clerk.

stages.name: Main Exam
stages.tests: 200 Qs, 160 min. Reasoning, English, Quant, GA, Computer. + Descriptive (letter + essay).
stages.note: Merit prepared from Main score. Descriptive qualifying.

stages.name: Interview (PO/SO only)
stages.tests: 20-min panel. Banking awareness, current affairs, personality, situational questions.

stages.name: Document Verification
stages.tests: All originals, caste, domicile, NOC, gap certificate.
stages.note: Any discrepancy = rejection. Verify before applying.

reality: IBPS PO and SBI PO are the most competitive. 10 lakh+ applicants for 4000–5000 vacancies.
Clerk has no interview — pure merit. PO has interview (20% weight). Focus accordingly.
Banking exams test speed + accuracy. 60 min for 100 Qs in Prelims = 36 sec per question.
SBI PO has group exercise + interview (different from IBPS). Prepare for group discussion.
RRB (Regional Rural Bank) exams are easier than IBPS/SBI but fewer vacancies and lower pay.
RBI Grade B is the most prestigious banking exam. Requires deeper economics/finance knowledge.

faq.q: What is the difference between IBPS PO and SBI PO?
faq.a: IBPS PO recruits for 11 public sector banks (excluding SBI). SBI PO recruits only for SBI. SBI PO has group exercise + interview; IBPS PO has only interview. SBI PO pay is slightly higher.

faq.q: Can a 12th pass apply for bank jobs?
faq.a: Yes, for Clerk posts (IBPS Clerk, SBI Clerk, RRB Office Assistant). PO and SO require graduation. RBI Grade B requires graduation or post-graduation depending on the post.

faq.q: What is the age limit for banking exams?
faq.a: Clerk: 20–28 years. PO: 20–30 years. SO: 20–30 years. RBI Grade B: 21–30 years. Age relaxations: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, PwD 10 years.
IBPS PO: no attempt limit (age-based). SBI PO: no attempt limit. RBI Grade B: 6 attempts for General, no limit for SC/ST/OBC/PwD.

faq.q: Is there negative marking in banking exams?
faq.a: Yes. 0.25 marks deducted per wrong answer in both Prelims and Mains. No negative marking in descriptive paper or interview.

faq.q: Where do I find official banking notifications?
faq.a: ibps.in (IBPS), sbi.co.in/careers (SBI), rbi.org.in (RBI), ibps.in (RRB). SarkariJobs+ links the official notification on every listing page.
